PudoFlights.text:
query PudoFlights(
    $arrivalAirport: String
    $arrivalISODate: String
    $departureAirport: String
    $departureTimeMsec: Float! 
    $pageNumber: Int
    $pageSize: Int
    $type: EnumRVWebCommonFlightSearchType
    $query: String!
  ) {
    pudoFlights(
      arrivalAirport: $arrivalAirport
      arrivalISODate: $arrivalISODate
      departureAirport: $departureAirport
      departureTimeMsec: $departureTimeMsec
      pageNumber: $pageNumber
      pageSize: $pageSize
      type: $type
      query: $query
    ) {
      ...PudoFlightFragment
    }
  }
fragment PudoFlightFragment on RVWebCommonPudoFlight {
    airlineCode
    airlineName
    arrivalAirportCode
    arrivalTimeMsec
    departureAirportCode
    departureTimeMsec
    departureTimeLocal
    number
    uuid
  }
